messages.text: Thursday, September 24 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn's first crisp air, jazz notes, and a town's future
A mostly clear Thursday arrives with crisp autumn air and a high near 70°F. Look for jazz performances in Ann Arbor and discussions on Ann Arbor's downtown property sale.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 51°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:24 AM and sunset is at 7:27 PM, with the moon appearing as a waxing gibbous, 93.4% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's evening sounds and sights
For a taste of jazz, consider Fresh Berrys. at El Limon at 6:00 PM, or Pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House at 7:30 PM.
Evil Gigawatt's birthday is today, September 24.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown property sale funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the $14.2 million to $17.4 million expected from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Friday brings film and music
Tomorrow, catch a free outdoor screening of 'Best in Show' at Campus Martius Park in Detroit, or attend Dolly Day at the Ann Arbor District Library.
Satellites navigate without GPS, new cancer treatment advances

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves.
The Starship launch schedule is unset, with no official date listed for its next attempt.
A clear sky offers many paths to discovery.
Friday, September 25 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Overcast Skies, Music Fills the Air

An overcast but warm Friday in Canton offers a variety of cultural experiences. From live music performances to a community arts celebration, there are opportunities to engage locally. Meanwhile, the University of Michigan is advancing cancer research with soundwave treatments.
Today will be overcast with a high near 69°F and a low around 46°F, with a minimal chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:25 AM and sunset is at 7:26 PM, under a full moon that is 97.6% illuminated.
Local Music and Arts Today
The Ann Arbor District Library is hosting Dolly Day starting at 5:30 PM, featuring crafts and concert videos. For music lovers, pianist Barron Ryan performs at Kerrytown Concert House at 6:30 PM.
Tomorrow, Ypsilanti kicks off The Big Read with a community event at the library plaza at 11:00 AM.
Ann Arbor Allocates Funds from Downtown Property Sale

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a plan to spend between $14.2 million and $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. These funds will support 12 different projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy initiatives.
Weekend Music and Nature Events
Tomorrow, consider a Community Bio Blitz at Eliza Howell Park in Detroit at 10:00 AM. For music, The Ark in Ann Arbor features multiple performances, including The Bros. Landreth at 7:30 PM.
NASA Satellites Navigate Autonomously, Roman Telescope Ready

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras. Additionally, the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has cleared its flight-readiness review and is proceeding to final launch preparations.
The next Starship launch is not officially scheduled; independent estimates place it no earlier than September 18, 2026.
Let the evening's offerings guide your attention.
